steps.content: Fine sweat beads on Hypatia's brow. Though her mastery of Aurum Secretum far exceeds Saina's, it still takes every shred of her strength to bend the material just enough to pin her opponent down.
The two of them hold there, locked, each breathing hard, neither yielding an inch.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I don't wish to harm you... Please, don't make me do this.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: We are not the killers. At the Furor ruins, there was a third force present, apart from us and the Luminaris representative. The Luminaris Society has long been collaborating with the Underground. That scholar never suspected them... which is why he was caught defenseless in the sudden attack.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: There are no Hypercubes in the ruins. It was a trap set by the Underground—using false intelligence to lure the leaders, aiming to capture every neutral faction of the Farland Alliance at once! When we uncovered their plot, they immediately shifted blame, framing us as murderers while still achieving their goal: escalating the conflict.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Margaret has already warned you about the truth. Why can't you let this go?!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Heh... Truth? How many honest words have ever come from a Disian's mouth? You're all liars! All this damn contamination was brought by you!! This tear zone stands as proof of your crimes!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You want the farlands threatened and oppressed forever. You can't stand to see us live decent lives. That's why you're after those Hypercubes. Starting with that bird-woman, none of you deserve anything but misery. Don't even think about leaving the WhiteSands alive.
At those words, the last thread of Hypatia's restraint finally snaps.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What did you do to Margaret?!
Saina's eyes dart between the Aurum Secretum spider and Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Her? She's finished. Hehehe... You hear me? That bird-woman has been taken. It's over for her!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Now that I'm in your clutches, I accept my fate. Drop the false pity! Go on! Kill me!!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Even in death, I'll be the spark that ignites the rage of every farlander... then... I'll drag you down to hell with me!
Blinded by rage, Saina explodes with sudden, shocking strength, driving her head violently into the Gilded Machina that binds her.
The impact hammers through Hypatia, staggering her backward, her weapon nearly flying from her grip.
Blood gushes from the wound on Saina's brow, running over the Aurum Secretum tracings. The metal drinks it in, and a thick, sanguine aura erupts from her body, heavy and suffocating.
She closes in, each step a dark, bloodied stamp in the white sand. The utter madness in her eyes is a chilling, visceral threat.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No... why...
Nearly stunned by this raw, self-annihilating hatred, Hypatia recoils, her back hitting a ruined wall.
She can't...
She can't confront her like this.

In that moment, the dove streaks into view, intercepting Saina head-on. It moves with preternatural agility. Even when struck, it merely dissipates partially before cohering again, a phantom of energy and will.

Meanwhile, more Aurum Secretum Warriors have locked onto their position. Seeing Rust's injuries and his struggle against the numbers, they split their forces with chilling efficiency—one group pressing Rust, the other advancing on Hypatia.
This can't continue. Rust needs treatment. Now.
Hypatia takes a breath, forcing calm as her eyes sweep their surroundings.
Their car is a half-crushed wreck. No other vehicle in sight. They can run, but they need cover, a hidden place, and fast.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: We can go in there.

An intense calamity tear comes into view. The area is a churning mass of perpetual storms and thick, vile contamination. The sky burns with a sickly purple-red hue, split now and then by jagged veins of lightning.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's a catastrophe tear zone... a Mania zone that formed after the catastrophes shifted course following BR-005. Anomalies erupt there with unnatural frequency, and the terrain can reshape itself within a day. Once inside, we'd be difficult to track.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Both Mr. Rust and I are Sinners. Our innate resistance to Mania is higher than that of ordinary people... even Aurum Secretum Warriors.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: If we hide in there, we might just lose them for good.
The growl of the engine returning to life cuts through the chaos like a command.

Rust evades a blade, weaves quick sorceries around his closest pursuers, and pulls back. As he passes the white dove, he lends his momentum to its strike, a unified blow that throws Saina off her feet.
The off-roader races alongside him. At the last second, Rust drops smoothly into the passenger seat.
His eyes follow Hypatia's gaze ahead, and he understands their destination instantly.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: So that's your plan? A bit dangerous. Thrilling, though. It's one way to go, I suppose.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Go when you're ready. I'll handle the monsters. Remember, your only job is to protect your heart.

Before Hypatia can process his meaning, her foot stamps the accelerator. The car groans like a dying creature, lurching clear of the closing encirclement as it speeds toward the terrifying tear in the earth.
Saina, seeing her prey escape, charges after them in a blind rage.
Then, the vehicle plunges into the tear.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You're not getting away!!
Saina's enraged cries vanish behind them as the battered off-roader plunges headlong into the storm-ravaged catastrophe zone.
Weightlessness hits instantly. The violent tempest seizes the vehicle, tossing it like a child's toy.
The metal frame shrieks as panels peel away like paper. There is no control here, only the fight to remain aware as the world tears itself apart around them.
The vehicle does not land. At last, it comes apart in midair, shredded by the furious Mania.
The two are thrown clear like broken dolls, tumbling into the chaotic, lightless depths of the tear.
